errors.text_span: Ос X е обозначена като „Дни“ и представлява времеви диапазон, започващ от 15 Април 2021 г.  Тя използва линейна скала,  обхващаща стойностите между 1 и 239, и е обозначена на интервали от 20 дни.  Ос Y е обозначена като „цени на нефта на нефт“ и използва линейна скала, варираща от 60 до 130.  Всички стойности са отбелязани на интервали от 10 единици.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly treats the two separate plots as a single chart with shared axes. It conflates the x-axis of the left plot (dates) with the x-axis of the right plot (days 1-239), leading to a completely erroneous description of the axes.
Neither x-axis in the figure is labeled. The description hallucinates the label "Дни" (Days).

errors.text_span: Ос Y е обозначена като „цени на нефта на нефт“
errors.evidence: The y-axis is not labeled in either plot. The description hallucinates a label. The wording "цени на нефта на нефт" is also grammatically awkward.
The y-axis on both plots ranges from 50 to 130, not 60 to 130.
The first line, labeled "Real price data", is black, not blue.

errors.text_span: Тя започва от приблизително 68 на 15 Април 2021 г.
errors.evidence: The first line starts at a value of approximately 63, not 68.
The line does not end at 128. On 15 March 2022, the value is approximately 110. The line peaks around 128 earlier in March and ends around 105.
The second line, labeled "Jump-diffusion simulated price", is a solid line, not a dotted or dashed (пунктирана) line.
The second line starts at a value of approximately 103 at day 1, not 58.
The second line ends at day 239 with a value of approximately 53. The description incorrectly states it ends at 118 (which is close to its peak value) and gives a date from the other chart's x-axis.
The values for the second line actually vary between approximately 52 and 118.

errors.text_span: достига най-ниската си стойност около 73 на 169 дните
errors.evidence: The lowest value of the second line is approximately 52, which occurs around day 183, not 73 at day 169.

errors.text_span: и най-високата си стойност на 127 на 19 дните
errors.evidence: The highest value of the second line is approximately 118, which occurs around day 71. The value 127 is incorrect, as is the location at day 19.

errors.text_span: Тя показва често спадове и гледки
errors.evidence: The word "гледки" (sights/views) is nonsensical in this context and is likely a typo for a word like "върхове" (peaks).
